tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zla gsang las rgyun bsnyen gyi zhal gdams shin tu gsang ba bzhugs so//

ya mā ri na mo/ zla gsang gzhi bsnyen dang zlog bsad mnan sogs kyi sgrub pa'i dmigs pa rnams rang gzhung so sor gsal la/ rgyun bsnyen sngags gsum po gang byed kyang ngag 'don dkyus ma'i bsrung ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas srung sngags ci nus bzlas rjes/ rang gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar bzla bya'i sngags kyis bskor ba/ sngags bzlas pa'i tshe nyi ma dang rdo rje hūm̐ yig rnams mi 'gul bar sngags phreng drag la myur bar g.yas su rgyun mi 'chad du 'khor zhing sngags phreng sa bon rdo rje dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs dang mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad bsdus pa sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas par bstims/ slar yang 'od 'phros/ rigs drug gi sems can rnams la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i go 'phang la bkod/ de rnams kyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor srog lus dbang thang rlung rta'i stobs rnams dang*/ 'byung ba lnga'i ro bcud nus pa thams cad bsdus te sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas par bstims/ slar 'od 'phros pas/ dgra bgegs gnod byed thams cad la phog pas de dag thams cad dbang du bsdus shing bran du bkol/ ma 'dus pa rnams tshar bcad/ de rnams kyi phun tshogs thams cad bsdus te sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim zhing 'khor bar gyur/ oṃ a kro te ka ya mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces don dran bzhin yid gzhan du mi 'phro bar bzlas pa bya'o// rgyun bsnyen gyi rtags ni/ zla gsang 'jam dpal thugs kyi rgyud rtsa ba chen po'i le'u sum cu par/ a kro te ka rgyun gyi sngags// de dag sgrub pa'i dus su yang*// mi lus phra men mgo can sar// yun dang bran 'khor pha ma dang*// mchod rten chen po ston pa dang*// me chen rtag tu 'bar ba dang*// rgya mtsho dag tu mi nub dang*// de dag ma byung bar du bgrang*// zhes gsungs shing*/

zla gsang dregs pa tshar gcod kyi le'u nyer gsum par yang 'di kho na ltar gsungs pas rtags 'di rnams rgyun bsnyen gyi gzhi bsnyen dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor sogs kyi rtags yin no/ /zhes pa'ang rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde'i ljags bsgrigs yin zhing*/ gshin rje mkhan gyis thugs khur bzhes rgyur/ gzhan rnams la ni/ gzhi bsnyen gyi sngags bsdebs/ zhal gdams/ las sbyor rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa rnams ha cang dar che zhing*/ rgyun bsnyen 'di'ang yod pa ni su zhig gis ma mthong bas de ltar nyams su len shes dang gzhan la'ang gsang shes byed pa gal che'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
